claim: We are raising $3 million to fund the next product milestone and buy 18 months of runway.
We are raising $2 million to fund a 12-month runway and reach the next financing milestone.
Our total addressable market is $8 billion and we expect to capture 5% within three years.
Our target segment includes 40,000 eligible clinics with a reachable sales channel and stated buyer budget.
Our product saves customer-support teams four hours per week, based on 20 pilot interviews.
Our product completes support-ticket triage and reduces average handling time by 30%.
Our AI model achieves 98% accuracy and 200 ms latency on 40 internal test examples.
Our patented algorithm has a 99.2% uptime benchmark and responds in under 200 milliseconds.
We charge $99 per seat per month and expect an 85% gross margin at scale.
Our annual recurring revenue is $1.2 million, customer acquisition cost is $500, and monthly churn is 3%.
Established competitors cannot copy our proprietary workflow, and we have no direct competitors.
Incumbents bundle similar software, and buyers face high switching costs when changing providers.
Our founder has scaled two B2B companies, but we lack an operations leader.
The founding team has delivered three enterprise launches and has a named owner for sales execution.
We need GDPR compliance, explicit consent, and a data deletion policy before launch.
Our product stores sensitive customer recordings, so retention limits and access controls must meet applicable rules.
Our supplier can manufacture 10,000 units a month at 98% yield with current tooling.
Our production process depends on one supplier and has not yet demonstrated repeatable yield at higher volumes.
A strategic acquisition could provide an exit, but we have not identified a likely acquirer.
Our exit thesis depends on a public listing and a clear path to required reporting standards.
The customer pain point occurs daily, costs buyers several hours a week, and is handled through a manual workaround.
Teams currently combine spreadsheets and email because the core workflow is fragmented and time-consuming.
The pitch-deck headline calls us the only industry leader and the positioning needs clearer proof.
The pitch narrative leads with a broad promise before identifying the target buyer and the problem.
